content:
# Add ACK-managed Logs Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

## 1. Base manifests — `infra/s3/logs/`

```yaml
# infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
# bucket policy applied by IRSA role below
```

```yaml
# infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
    knr-ops.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1            # overridden per overlay
    versioning:
      - enabled: true
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
      - rule:
          - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              - sseAlgorithm: AES256
    tags:
      Environment: placeholder   # overridden per overlay
      ManagedBy: ack
```

```yaml
# infra/s3/logs/public-access-block.yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops.io/component: logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

## 2. IRSA Role — `infra/iam/logs-irsa/base/`

```yaml
# infra/iam/logs-irsa/base/role.yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": { "Federated": "${OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN}" },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "${OIDC_HOST}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
              "${OIDC_HOST}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
            }
          }
        }]
      }
    tags:
      ManagedBy: ack
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "${BUCKET_ARN}"
          },
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload", "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
            ],
            "Resource": "${BUCKET_ARN}/*"
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops.io/component: logs-irsa
    policyArnSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops.io/component: logs-irsa
```

The OIDC provider ARN/host differ per cluster → SOPS-encrypt the OIDC trust details per env:

```yaml
# overlays/dev/secret.sops.yaml (SOPS-encrypted; shown as structure)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-oidc
type: Opaque
stringData:
  OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTER
  OIDC_HOST: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTER
```

## 3. Overlays

```yaml
# overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../../infra/iam/logs-irsa/base
  - secret.sops.yaml
patches:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
      kind: Bucket
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/tags/Environment
        value: dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
replacements:
  - source:
      kind: Secret
      name: logs-irsa-oidc
      version: v1
    targets:
      - select:
          group: iam.aws.upbound.io
          kind: Role
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
```

```yaml
# overlays/prod/logs/kustomization.yaml
# same as dev, with name: myapp-logs-prod, Environment: prod,
# region per prod overlay (us-east-1), and its own SOPS secret
# referencing the prod cluster OIDC provider.
```

(For prod, keep least-privilege: no wildcards — the policy above already scopes to the single bucket ARN, which meets AC #4.)

## 4. Flux kustomization — `flux/`

```yaml
# flux/kustomizations-logs.yaml
---
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: knr-ops
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  ref:
    branch: main
  secretRef:
    name: flux-ssh-credentials   # existing
  url: ssh://git@github.com/org/knr-ops.git
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
```

## Notes

- **Env isolation**: dev/prod are separate Flux Kustomizations and separate kustomize overlays — reconciling prod never touches dev state (AC #7).
- **SOPS**: OIDC trust config (account/cluster-specific) is the only sensitive data; Flux decrypts it in-cluster via the `sops` decryption provider.
- **Service account annotation** (app side): `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::<acct>:role/myapp-logs-irsa` on `myapp/logs-writer`.
